programme.title: The Mighty One
programme.desc: Lung seeks five volumes of a renowned Kung Fu manual to gain invincibility. When he believes a martial arts school master possesses the volumes, he kills him and his daughter but leaves behind a young brother and sister.

programme.title: The Three Smiles
programme.desc: A talented scholar, Bo Hu, is attracted by the pretty maid, Qiu Xiang. In order to get close to her and win her love, he disguises as a servant to work in the same household.

programme.title: Ambush
programme.desc: A group of young elite commandos, led by Captain Drummond are tasked with collecting highly classified information that can change the fate of the war.

programme.title: The Empress Dowager
programme.desc: In 5000 years of Chinese history, there was never a more fascinating woman than the dragon lady of the Ching Dynasty, also the Empress Dowager, who was the power behind the throne for the last half of the 19th century.

programme.title: The Fantastic Magic Baby
programme.desc: In The Fantastic Magic Baby, director Chang Che weaves a wild and woolly yarn about how the legendary Monkey King and Goddess of Mercy battle and defeat the child god Hung Hai-erh then point him down the road to righteousness.

programme.title: Between Tears And Smiles
programme.desc: Kwan Shan must save the woman he loves (Li Li-hua), before she is presented as a gift to the General!

programme.title: The Vengeful Beauty
programme.desc: The Flying Guillotine assassins are secretly working for the Emperor and its leader Jin is sent to kill Hon, who knows this secret. Hon’s pregnant wife Rong seeks to kill Jin but retreats to protect her unborn child.

programme.title: The Shepherd Girl
programme.desc: The Shepherd Girl, a heartwarming 1963 musical from Shaw Brothers! In this musical drama, Julie Yeh Feng stars as Hsiu Hsiu, a beautiful shepherd girl who falls in love with a handsome boatman named Liu Ta-lung

programme.title: The Duel
programme.desc: After knowing his brother has killed the head of a rival triad, Jie takes the blame and was hunted by killers. With the help of Rambler Nan, Jie finally killed his enemies, but then found out that Nan is the one who has killed his father.

programme.title: West Chamber
programme.desc: The story is based on a famous Chinese opera. A young impoverished scholar, Zhang, is enchanted by Hong, the daughter of an influential family whom he meets in a temple.

programme.title: The Invincible Fist
programme.desc: Here Lo Lieh (future international star of King Boxer) plays a dedicated chief constable for Tsang Chou village, who falls in love with the blind daughter of a bandit who is wreaking havoc.

programme.title: Hex Vs Witchcraft
programme.desc: Yu Nan (Yi Lei) is a compulsive gambler. He makes his wife as a down payment for his debt, feeling regretted and decides to kill himself but stops when a beautiful ghost appears.

programme.title: Madam White Snake
programme.desc: Linda Lin Dai is perfect as Pak Su-cheng, the stunning snake goddess who assumes a womanly form so that she can taste the pleasures of a human life!

programme.title: Spring Blossoms
programme.desc: Some of Shaw Brothers biggest female stars of the 1970s share the screen in this tale of young love and interfering parents, starring Lily Li, Shu Pei Pei and Essie Lin Chia.

programme.title: The Mermaid
programme.desc: Zhang and Jins daughter, Peony, are betrothed at birth but Jin objects to the engagement now. Zhang meets a carp spirit that looks exactly like Peony and they fall in love.

programme.title: Shaolin Rescuers
programme.desc: Hong Xi Guan of Shaolin is chased and wounded by a martial arts scum who took refuge in the Qing court. He is saved and healed by friends from the wet market and they hide Hong in a bean curd shop to protect him.

programme.title: Lets Fall In Love
programme.desc: Legendary actress Lin Feng Jiao stars in this romantic comedy as an unlikely romance occurs between an entrepreneurs son and a kindergartens principals niece.

programme.title: Brothers Five
programme.desc: A young woman sets out to reunite feuding brothers to take out a gang of killers who have murdered their father.

programme.title: The Land Of Many Perfumes
programme.desc: Monk Tang San Zang, Monkey, Pigsy and Sha Wu Jing find themselves in Womanland, where women give birth to baby girls by drinking the magical spring water.

programme.title: My Rebellious Son
programme.desc: A corrupt official attempts to steal a priceless Buddha statue from a temple to please a group of Westerners. Luckily, Doctor Zhang and his son manage to defeat the enemies and save the Buddha statue.

programme.title: The Butterfly Chalice
programme.desc: Action maestro Chang Cheh tells the story of Chin Feng, who meets the beautiful Ting Hung while on the run for accidentally killing an arrogant bully.

programme.title: The Black Tavern
programme.desc: An inn where the down and dirty meet to plot nefarious doings. A bunch of villains are lured to the inn by a rumour about a valuable treasure being hidden there.

programme.title: The Adulteress
programme.desc: In the waning day of the Ching Dynasty, the son of the local magistrate murdered a peddler and raped his wife. The wife had been framed for her husbands murder by the rapist.

programme.title: Ambitious Kung Fu Girl
programme.desc: The lovely Michelle Mei Suet plays a spoiled girl Szu-szu who ignores her true love Yang Fan to go off in search of a swordsman Chin Ko she idolizes.

programme.title: Lady General Hua Mu-Lan
programme.desc: This legendary tale of courage and heroism stars Ivy Ling Po as Mulan, the young woman who joined the army and became a true heroine of the Chinese people.

programme.title: Killer Constable
programme.desc: No one is more dedicated than Chief Court Constable Chan Koon Tai, whose obsessive loyalty sends him after a homicidal thief who thinks nothing of sending his men to their deaths.

programme.title: Melody Of Love
programme.desc: This delightful romance story tells the story of three doctors pursuing three beauties who play hard-to-get in the a-go-go era of the 70s.

programme.title: Song Of Orchid Island
programme.desc: Paul Chang Chung plays Dr. Ho, who decides to move to a backward island off the coast of Taiwan to look for his missing father.

programme.title: Holy Flame Of Martial World
programme.desc: In revenge for the killing of their parents, a brother and sister hunt down the killer by using two legendary scepters.

programme.title: The Love Eterne
programme.desc: The glorious Betty Loh Ti stars as a beauty who disguises herself as a boy in order to receive a forbidden education in this multi award-winning drama from director Li Han Hsiang.

programme.title: The Naval Commandos
programme.desc: The Chinese Navy is attempting to defend its coastline from a Japanese attack, they send their commando unit led by Cui Hsia into the mainland to enlist help to thwart the Japanese before they attack.

programme.title: The Magnificent Concubine
programme.desc: Yang Gui Fei is the beloved concubine of Emperor. He is besotted with her that he leaves the running of the country to Prime Minister. The Prime Minister is corrupt, causing them to revolt the throne.

programme.title: Rivals Of Kung Fu
programme.desc: Everyone wants to win the annual Lion Dance Trophy, including Wong Fei Hung. His jealous rivals, led by Master Shen, try to frame Wong by placing a decomposed corpse in his Po Chi Lam clinic.

programme.title: The Crazy Bumpkins
programme.desc: This side-splitting comedy sees naive Ah Niu (Ya Feng) head to HK, where he is repeatedly exploited and taken advantage of, and eventually finds himself arrested and imprisoned.

programme.title: Night And Fog
programme.desc: Following “The Way We Are”, this is based on a true story happening in Tin Shui Wai. It revolves around an older, unemployed Hong Kong man, his young Mainland wife and their two daughters. Their lives, unfortunately, are anything but easy, and the shocking conclusion raises issues about the plight of the socially deprived lower class.

programme.title: Cyber Heist
programme.desc: Hackers have caused a large-scale cyber attack and Chuns boss is the mastermind of the attack. When Chun gets trapped in a money laundering operation, he must fight to prove his innocence in the cyber world.

programme.title: My Country, My Parents
programme.desc: The movie depicts how the fathers forge ahead through the struggle of times, defending strong family ties and passing on the fighting spirit through generations.

programme.title: Vanguard
programme.desc: A businessman Qin Guo Li is being kidnapped in London and his daughter is also in danger. The international security team, Vanguard, is hired to rescue them. In the process, they discover another dangerous conspiracy.

programme.title: Chasing The Dragon
programme.desc: Crippled Ho came to Hong Kong as an illegal immigrant in 1963 and ruthlessly carved an empire from the chaotic underworld of drug dealers and corrupt police that ruled the city under notorious detective Lee Rock.

programme.title: An Abandoned Team
programme.desc: An irritable elderly man joins a team rescuing stray dogs. As they work together to save abandoned animals, the groups efforts demonstrate how compassion can change lives for both humans and canines.

programme.title: City Of Desire
programme.desc: Sandra returns to Macau after having been in Canada for the last twenty years. Her father is ill and the business is being passed on to her, but she is taken aback to discover that the family business is prostitution.

programme.title: The Last Dance
programme.desc: A debt-ridden wedding planner inadvertently becomes a successful funeral planner, but he must convince a traditional Taoist priest of his legitimacy to continue operating in the field.

programme.title: Young And Dangerous: Reloaded
programme.desc: In this remake of “Young and Dangerous”, Chan Ho Nam and his three buddies of the Hung Hing triad gang strive to fight for their own justice, further expanding their power in the triad and becoming a new legend...

programme.title: Undercover Hidden Dragon
programme.desc: Fat, who suffers from amnesia, believing that he is actually an undercover policeman, Fat attempts to arrest gang leader Big Bro, but instead becomes the gangsters best ally.

programme.title: The Rescue
programme.desc: An emergency occurs on an offshore drilling rig that would cause it to capsize and sink. The Emergency Response Unit races against the clock in a chopper rescue mission amidst dangerous explosions and fire.

programme.title: The Sunny Side Of The Street
programme.desc: Hassans father has died in a car accident. A local taxi driver, Yat, then helps him flee Hong Kong. They gradually develop a father-son relationship, until Hassan discovers the shocking truth about his fathers death.

programme.title: Love Is Blind, Hate Too
programme.desc: Bo lost her eye sight in a serious car accident a year ago. One day, an intruder enters Bos house and takes her hostage. Then, she discovers her husbands secret which is related to her accident last year.

programme.title: Everything Is Unknown
programme.desc: Pan Yi Ming receives his fathers will stating that he must attend his funeral at home to claim the huge inheritance. When he returns home, he encounters his ex-girlfriend, her husband Hua Qi and his daughter whom he has never met.

programme.title: Dummy Mommy, Without A Baby
programme.desc: Fong Lai Kuen works at an advertising agency but is about to be sacked by her boss after offending him. She pretends to be pregnant so that the company cannot fire her, according to the labour law.

programme.title: Inexternal
programme.desc: After a brutal beating, Chet falls into a coma. In a dream world, he trains with Sifu Turtle in Burmese boxing to defeat a villain, while his fate hinges on his mothers actions in the real world.

programme.title: The Last Dance
programme.desc: A debt-ridden wedding planner inadvertently becomes a successful funeral planner, but he must convince a traditional Taoist priest of his legitimacy to continue operating in the field.

programme.title: Love And Let Love!
programme.desc: Cliff proposes to his girlfriend Terry but is killed in a car accident before she says “yes”. Terry is devastated and inconsolable. When Cliffs ghost returns, they seem to go back to their good old days. However, Cliff is determined to help Terry get over his death and start anew.

programme.title: Fatal Visit
programme.desc: Yanny leaves Hong Kong for San Jose to visit her old friend Ling. Ling and her husband Tang seems to live an ideal and carefree life. However, during her five-day stay, Yanny uncovers the truth behind the facade.

programme.title: Remember What I Forgot
programme.desc: An unknown film director who is pursuing his dream and unremittingly pursuing a career in film.

programme.title: Just 1 Day
programme.desc: An urban sketcher suffering from ALS wants to create some fond memories as his condition worsens. Then, he asks his old classmate to fulfill his one last wish by becoming his girlfriend for just one day.

programme.title: Raging Fire
programme.desc: As the police sets to arrest a drug lord, a team of masked thugs steals the drugs. Inspector Bong discovers that the killers are led by Ngo, a former fellow cop who was forced into a life of crime by him.

programme.title: Mad Fate
programme.desc: A Master fortune teller predicts that Tung, a born psychopath, will be imprisoned for murder and tries to change his fate. A veteran detective believes Tung is a psychopathic serial killer after witnessing him kill a cat, and pursues him relentlessly. Can the Master change Tung’s mad fate?

programme.title: Lan Kwai Fong
programme.desc: Lee is the Production head of an advertising firm who tries to improve her teams performance by competing with Creative head Chan in the day and clubbing at Lan Kwai Fong for ideas at night.

programme.title: Those Were The Days
programme.desc: Director Wong despises Cantonese movies of the 60s, but accidentally travels back in time to that movie set. He meets Director Chu, who tells him he can return to modern time if someone likes the film he makes. Wong meets four classic movie stars and invites them to star in his new film, but it flops unexpectedly. Can Wong return to the present?

programme.title: Shadows
programme.desc: Ching is a forensic psychiatrist who has the power to enter a person’s subconscious mind. In her latest case, she suspects that another psychiatrist is responsible for a brutal murder-cum-suicide case involving a social worker. In the investigation process, Ching finds herself under suspicion instead, as she comes face-to-face with a past trauma…

programme.title: Only Cloud Knows
programme.desc: This romantic drama is based on the story of a real-life couple. It follows a grieving husband as he journeys to places of significance to his beloved dead wife across their New Zealand homeland.

programme.title: Schemes In Antiques
programme.desc: When an antique is to be returned to China, Xu Yuan uncovers an ancient mystery and soon embarks on a journey that can finally restore his familys reputation but may also cost him his life.

programme.title: I Corrupt All Cops
programme.desc: There was a dark age when corruption and bribery were the order of the day in Hong Kong. One day, comes brave individuals who are determined to end corruption with the founding of Hong Kongs anti-corruption bureau.

programme.title: Lost Love
programme.desc: Chan Tin Mei (Sammi Cheng) and Ho Bun (Alan Luk)s son passes away abruptly at just three years old due to congenital heart disease. Suffering in unfathomable pain over the loss, Mei resists having another child. One day, Mei finds out that they can become a foster family.

programme.title: CGTN Documentary
programme.desc: Launched on Jan. 1, 2011, CGTN Documentary is the only Chinese TV channel to broadcast documentaries in English 24/7. The channel broadcasts over 1,000 episodes of new programs each year, including top quality documentaries such as “A Bite of China”, “Wild Wonders”, and the 100-episode “A History of China”. CGTN Documentary is an ideal platform for people around the world to learn about Chinas past and present, and is dedicated to promoting the best of Chinese documentaries.
